subject: Novus Health pilot — post-demo, economic buyer & budget next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novushealth.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novus Health pilot — post-demo, economic buyer & budget next steps

Thanks again for your time today, Alicia — appreciated the candid discussion. Quick recap from our 30-min demo and suggested next steps: 

What we covered
- Demo: hosted and dedicated options, latency & cost tradeoffs, caching/quantization approach.
- Customer scenario: 2–3 production endpoints for inference-heavy workflows (clinical note summarization + document search).
- Primary concerns you raised: data residency, SOC 2 evidence, and predictable monthly spend.

Decision criteria we heard (as I understand it)
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 + signed DPA, option for VPC/private deployment if needed.
- Economics: clear per-token unit cost or reserved capacity commitment.
- Performance: p99 latency targets for the summarization route (~150–200ms).

Asks / next steps
1) Identify the economic buyer / budget owner — you mentioned Finance may need to sign off; any chance you can introduce the person who owns the budget for pilot/PO?
2) Procurement checklist: I attached a short SOC 2 summary and the mutual action plan (MAP) draft. Alicia/Procurement: can you confirm which vendor paperwork we should prepare (standard SOW + DPA or anything else)?
3) Meeting: propose a 30-min call next week with the budget owner + procurement to align on scope and PO timing. I included a booking link here: https://cal.com/jasmine/novus-next-step

Attachments: 20260514-demo-recording.mp4 (recording), novus-mvp-mutual-action-plan.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If it helps, a short intro note to the budget owner from you would accelerate things — I can follow with a concise one-pager and tailored pricing options (hosted pilot vs reserved capacity).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jmliu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
Note: internal follow-up actions for Markus/Dev: confirm pilot pricing tiers and capacity cushion for Novus's expected QPS.
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novushealth.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novushealth.ai>, procurement@novushealth.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus Health pilot — post-demo, economic buyer & budget next steps

Thanks, Jasmine — great demo and very clear recap.

Quick answers:
- Procurement: loop included (procurement@novushealth.ai). They will want the SOC 2 artifacts + our standard vendor questionnaire answered.
- Budget owner: I believe the budget sits with Marco Silva, VP Finance (marco.silva@novushealth.ai). He typically confirms pilots <$75k directly; anything above that requires CFO approval (Serena Valdez). I’ll introduce you to Marco if you send a short paragraph I can forward.
- Timeline: we’re aiming to kick pilots in Q3; procurement/finance cycles mean we should have a PO in mid-June if everything aligns.

Two procurement items to flag early: 1) data residency — Novus prefers US-only processing for PHI-adjacent data, and 2) vendor security questionnaires take ~7–10 business days to complete.

I’ll make a brief intro to Marco once you send the one-paragraph summary and the MAP.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product, Clinical Tools
Novus Health
agomez@novushealth.ai
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Silva <marco.silva@novushealth.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@novushealth.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro: Pilot summary + requested materials (brief)

Marco — nice to e-meet you. Alicia kindly offered to introduce the budget owner; below is a short summary and the MAP attached for your review. If it’s easier, happy to jump on a 20-min call.

One-paragraph summary for Marco:
Redwood helps teams run low-latency, cost-predictable LLM inference across hosted and private deployments. For Novus’s use case (clinical note summarization + search), we can deliver a hosted pilot that meets p99 latency targets (~150–200ms) while offering an optional private/VPC deployment if you require US-only processing. Attached is a proposed mutual action plan outlining scope, target metrics, and procurement steps.

Ask: would you confirm who signs PO (you vs Serena), and whether a mid-June PO timeline looks feasible? Procurement team — we’ve attached the redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and a short MAP; please advise on additional docs you need.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus Health pilot — internal pricing/commitment note

Jasmine — quick internal note before you loop Marco in further. A few pricing/ops points to keep in mind: 
- Offer structure: small hosted pilot (30 days, up to 500k tokens) at a fixed pilot fee ($12k) vs reserved 3-month Dedicated trial (committed vCPU/GPU lanes) — we should propose both and highlight upgrade path.
- Security: if Novus requires US-only processing + DPA amendments, that pushes them to our Private deployment; we should flag the lead time (~3–4 weeks for network setup).
- SLAs & fallbacks: include a clause about automatic fallback to an open-model hosted variant if there’s capacity disruption to avoid downtime.

Dev — can you prepare an estimated cost run for the two options (hosted pilot $12k vs 3-month reserved) and call out expected p99 under the payload (avg tokens per request ~1.2k)? Need that by EOD Tuesday to include in the MAP.

-Markus

Jasmine
